jobs.title: Portfolio Analytics & Strategy Manager Senior
jobs.description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As an Portfolio Analytics & Strategy Manager Senior within PNC's Data, Modeling, and Analytics organization, you will be based in Tysons Corner, VA, Vienna, VA or Pittsburgh PA.

PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.

PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description
- Provides financial and regulatory reporting and analyses to maintain adequate controls over the financial and regulatory reporting processes. Responsible for running complex business performance, risk and operational analytics. May include the development of analytical methods/models to assess market, credit and/or operational risk of new and existing financial products.
- Leverages business / product expertise to rigorously analyze large datasets, improve risk adjusted returns, deliver profitable growth, and communicate conclusions. Synthesizes analytical results and develops, recommends, and implements business strategies that improve lending decisions, assist in managing risk, increase revenues, reduce exposure to losses, meet business goals, and improve performance. Establishes baselines for strategies and tracks actual performance to expectations.
- Applies predictive models, third party data, and other tools to develop and execute appropriate segmentation and targeting for acquisition and portfolio strategies to provide insight into portfolio risk. Manages engagements with internal and external information suppliers ensuring solution is fit for purpose while maintaining appropriate governance and oversight.
- Understands and communicates regulatory and financial accounting impacts on the balance sheet to regulators and PNC control functions as appropriate. Interacts with regulators, internal audit, and management concerning credit portfolio analyses and credit risk appetite.
- Evaluates market conditions and peer bank behavior to identify internal and external trends and issues affecting credit risk and return and to determine appropriate risk limits and optimal portfolio allocation.
- Collaborates with the line of business, Finance, and Risk partners to assess and establish credit risk appetite and to understand its implications, as well as to establish policies and procedures governing the identification, monitoring, and management of risk appetite.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:
- Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
- Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

PNC also has fundamental expectations of our people managers. As a manager of talent in PNC, you will be expected to:
- Include Intentionally - Cultivates diverse teams and inclusive workplaces to expand thinking.
- Live the Values - Role models our values with transparency and courage.
- Enable Change - Takes action to drive change and innovation that will transform our business.
- Achieve Results - Takes personal ownership to deliver results. Empowers and trusts others in decision making.
- Develop the Best - Raises the bar with every talent decision and guides the achievement of all employees and customers.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Preferred Skills
Analytical Thinking, Credit Risks, Data Analytics, Financial Analysis, Model Development, Operational Risks, Quantitative Models, Risk Appetite

Competencies
Banking Products, Big Data Management and Analytics, Business Analytics, Credit Risk, Mathematics of Financial Instruments, Operational Risk, Predictive Analytics, Pricing Models and Analytics, Regulatory Environment - Financial Services

Work Experience
Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree. Higher level education such as a Masters degree, PhD, or certifications is desirable. Industry experience is typically 8+ years. At least 5 years of prior management experience is typically required. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.

Licenses

The Corporate Treasury Associate performs financial analysis, research, and reporting in support of the firm’s liquidity and balance-sheet management objectives. The analyst supports the accurate, timely, and controlled production of daily liquidity reporting, reviews results for reasonableness, investigates movements and exceptions, and maintains clear support for reported balances, cash flows, and liquidity measures.

The Associate remains close to market activity, with particular attention to interest-rate movements and their potential effects on funding conditions, cash flows, collateral, and the firm’s liquidity position. The role also supports the monitoring and management of intraday liquidity by assessing cash and payment activity, available liquidity resources, emerging funding needs, and material exceptions throughout the business day.

The role primarily supports FR 2052a and related liquidity reporting, with additional exposure to the Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), the Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR), and Internal Liquidity Stress Testing (ILST).

The Associate is expected to apply attention to detail, data gathering and reporting discipline, financial analysis, and effective communication while supporting established regulatory requirements, stress testing, remediation, and process improvements.

Working knowledge of FR 2052a, LCR, NSFR, ILST, or comparable liquidity and regulatory reporting frameworks.

jobs.title: Portfolio Analytics & Strategy Analyst Senior - Real Estate Market Analytics
jobs.description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Portfolio Analytics & Strategy Analyst Senior within PNC's Data, Modeling & Analytics Real Estate Market Analytics organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA, Chicago, IL or Cleveland, OH.

As a Portfolio Analytics & Strategy Analyst within the Real Estate Market Analytics (REMA) group you will be responsible for vetting real estate collateral for potential and existing PNC loans prior to ordering a third-party appraisal. Emphasis is placed on prospective asset performance due to a large level of new construction lending. Analyst will cross-check forward-looking developer proformas with existing market performance using industry leading data sources such as CoStar, CBRE-EA, MSCI, Yardi Matrix etc. and forecast future results. Forecasts include absorption (during lease-up), stabilized vacancy, market rent, rent growth, and concessions. Analyst must have a strong understanding of how local submarket performance is impacted by both MSA/regional and national economic trends and how to forecast appropriate market supply and demand trends.

In addition to the primary real estate types (i.e., multifamily, office, retail, & industrial), the analyst will evaluate mixed use, senior housing, student housing, tax credit, and lodging properties. While the analyst will focus largely on property level research for individual deals, macro-level industry data analysis is also routinely required for review and reporting of PNC portfolio performance or for macroeconomic reviews. The analyst will serve internal customers; the ability to multi-task and communicate timely and effectively with relationship managers, underwriters, and credit officers is instrumental in allowing PNC to develop an accurate picture of an asset and to issue competitive term sheets to gain new business. As part of the review, interviews of market experts, customers, brokers, leasing agents, and appraisers to get local views on the market are incorporated into the analysis. The analyst then writes a clear and concise summary of the supportive data and analysis for their conclusions/forecasts and presents to senior loan committee in conjunction with the deal team.

Other functions of the REMA group that the analyst may work on include criticized asset valuations, reconciling appraisal findings to internal underwriting, and quarterly sector studies. Appraisal, brokerage, real estate research, urban planning, macroeconomics, real estate property management, lending, or underwriting skills are all relevant. Argus skills are not required but are helpful.

Preferred skills and experience:

Bachelor's Degree and or an advanced degree plus 3+ years of related experience
Analytical mind and the ability to analyze a variety of data sources Relationship building skills
Strong interpersonal skills, communication skills and presentation skills

jobs.description:
Position Overview

As a Design Systems & Operations Lead within PNC's Treasury Management Digital organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA, Hamilton, NJ, or Houston, TX.

Role Summary:
This role sits at the intersection of Design Operations, Product Design, and Design Systems, partnering across Product, Research, Experience Design, UI, and Engineering teams to scale design quality, consistency, and delivery effectiveness.

This role operates horizontally across teams, ensuring that:
• Design systems are adopted and evolved based on real product needs.
• Design workflows are consistent, efficient, and scalable.
• Cross-crew alignment is strong between Design, Product, Research, and Engineering.

This role owns the effectiveness of the design delivery system, ensuring work is properly shaped, routed, governed, and delivered across Research, Experience Design, and Design System teams.

The role serves as an operator, orchestrator, and systems owner responsible for improving how work flows through the organization. This includes defining and optimizing operating models, enabling cross-functional collaboration, driving Design System adoption, and removing friction that slows teams down.
You will partner closely with Design Leadership to define DesignOps strategy while driving execution as a key operator and change agent across the organization.

This is a hands-on senior IC role that blends:
• Design delivery orchestration and operational leadership.
• Design System governance and adoption.
• Product design expertise and selective hands-on execution.
This role is ideal for a senior individual contributor who has experienced the challenges of scaling design organizations and has successfully built systems, processes, and operating models that improve delivery outcomes.

Core Responsibilities:

1. Design Operations & Cross-Crew Orchestration
Design Delivery System Ownership
• Own the health and effectiveness of the design delivery ecosystem across Research, Experience Design, and Design System teams.
• Act as the operational connector across disciplines, ensuring the right work reaches the right team at the right time with clearly defined goals, dependencies, and success criteria.
• Design and optimize workflows, rituals, and operating models both within Design and across Product and Engineering.
• Drive operational consistency while maintaining team agility and delivery velocity.
• Identify organizational friction points and actively remove barriers to execution.

Intake, Work Shaping & Prioritization
• Own and evolve intake and work-shaping processes to ensure initiatives are properly defined, assessed, and routed before entering delivery.
• Partner with leadership on intake management, prioritization, roadmap alignment, and delivery planning.
• Support capacity planning and resource visibility across teams.
• Ensure new work enters the system with appropriate context, ownership, objectives, and success measures.

Stage Gates, Dependencies & Delivery Readiness
• Define and maintain stage gates across discovery, design direction, design system alignment, development readiness, implementation QA, and delivery closure.
• Ensure clear design readiness for development and implementation.
• Surface and manage cross-crew dependencies, blockers, unresolved decisions, and operational risks.
• Establish escalation paths and governance mechanisms to maintain delivery flow and reduce rework.
• Facilitate critiques, working sessions, alignment forums, and operational reviews.

Visibility, Metrics & Continuous Improvement
• Create visibility into:
o What teams are designing.
o Where duplication or divergence is occurring.
o Where Design System opportunities exist.
o Where operational bottlenecks are slowing delivery.
• Define and track Design health metrics, delivery metrics, and Design System adoption measures.
• Monitor and improve the effectiveness of the design delivery system over time.

Success measures may include:
• Reduced design rework.
• Improved design readiness for development.
• Increased Design System adoption.
• Reduced one-off design solutions.
• Improved consistency across product experiences.
• Clearer ownership and accountability.
• Improved delivery flow and reduced operational friction.

2. Design System Ownership & Activation
• Govern, champion, and evolve the Design System in partnership with Design Leadership.
• Co-own the Design System roadmap, including components, tokens, patterns, templates, and supporting assets.
• Define organizational governance models and contribution processes for Design System enhancements.
• Establish clear inclusion criteria for system components versus custom solutions.
• Drive Design System adoption as both a product and operational discipline.
• Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to align teams around system usage and implementation standards.
• Enable teams through documentation, education, working sessions, office hours, and ongoing support.
• Facilitate Design System audits and adoption reviews to improve consistency across products.
• Support design-to-development parity throughout the implementation lifecycle.
• Partner with engineering teams to improve Design System implementation, scalability, and maintainability.

3. Product Design Leadership & Strategic Execution
• Lead or support select high-impact product initiatives where hands-on design involvement is required.
• Maintain direct exposure to product design work to inform operational improvements and Design System evolution.
• Establish quality benchmarks and best practices through participation in strategic initiatives.
• Create and deliver design concepts, workflows, prototypes, and experience solutions when needed.
• Partner with Product, Research, and Engineering teams to ensure experiences align with user needs and business goals.
• Support user research, usability testing, and iterative design improvements.
• Champion accessibility, usability, and responsive design best practices.
• Serve as a credible design practitioner capable of contributing to and evaluating design work across teams.

Technical Skills:

Must-Have
• Advanced Figma systems expertise (Components, Variants, Variables, Tokens, Libraries)
• Deep experience scaling and governing Design Systems.
• Strong UX and Product Design fundamentals across the end-to-end product lifecycle.
• Proven experience establishing or improving DesignOps functions, workflows, or operating models.
• Strong understanding of:
o Front-end architecture
o Component-based systems
o Responsive design principles
o Design-to-development workflows
• Experience working within Agile product delivery environments.
• Experience supporting cross-functional delivery models at scale.
• Accessibility (WCAG) expertise integrated into design practice.
• Experience defining metrics, performance indicators, and operational measures for design organizations.

Nice-to-Have
• Storybook and Design System tooling ecosystems.
• Design maturity assessment and organizational transformation experience.
• Process optimization, service design, or operating model design experience.
• Analytics and measurement frameworks for adoption, efficiency, and quality.

Soft Skills:

Must-Have
• Operator mindset (not strategist-only, not designer-only).
• Systems thinker who identifies patterns across teams and addresses root causes.
• Strong organizational and operational leadership skills without direct people management.
• Ability to influence peers, leaders, and cross-functional partners.
• Bias toward action, simplification, and continuous improvement.
• Ability to establish standards and governance without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
• Strong facilitation and alignment-building capabilities.
• Ability to navigate ambiguity and build structure where it does not yet exist.

Nice-to-Have
• High emotional intelligence and organizational awareness.
• Coaching and mentorship mindset.
• Executive communication and stakeholder management experience.
• Change management and organizational design experience.

Role Overview

The Business Analytics Lead on PNC’s Customer Interaction Management Strategy & Analytics team will develop, implement, and optimize PNC’s shopping strategy and advance the Next Best Action Marketing strategy within its broader customer interaction strategy. This role will shape analytical direction, improve decisioning effectiveness, and translate insights into practical strategies that enhance customer relevance, business performance, and execution consistency.

Shopping Strategy: Develop and implement strategies for shopping placement, experience design, governance, orchestration, testing, measurement, and optimization. This includes recommending, testing, and refining business rules and contact policies, optimizing placements and customer experiences, and incorporating customer context into presentments to improve engagement and outcomes.

Marketing Strategy: Stabilize and enhance the Next Best Action marketing ecosystem through improved data quality, marketing treatments and intents, decisioning, transparency, reporting, and measurement. The Business Analytics Lead will collaborate with teams across the Customer Interaction Management organization, PNC’s Next Best Action marketing ecosystem, and business functions across the bank to align analytical strategies with customer needs, business objectives, and operational capabilities. The role will influence decisions across analytics, marketing, digital, product, technology, and business teams to deliver scalable customer interaction improvements.

PNC is seeking a highly experienced Technology Risk Senior Manager to lead oversight of technology risk across critical enterprise technology functions and third-party service providers. This leadership role is responsible for establishing and executing risk strategies that support the Chief Technology Office (CTO), technology service delivery programs, and enterprise risk management objectives.

The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in technology risk and governance, leading teams, executive presence and communication, as well as experience in modern technology environments and programs including but not limited to: cloud infrastructure and platform services, APIs, enterprise architecture, asset management, and emerging technologies such as Generative AI and quantum computing. This role will serve as a trusted advisor to senior technology leaders, providing credible challenge, risk insights, and strategic guidance to strengthen PNC's technology risk posture while enabling innovation and business growth.

Job Responsibilities:

Technology Risk Leadership & Strategy

· Lead the Technology Risk function supporting the CTO organization and key enterprise technology programs.

· Establish and execute risk management strategies, standards, and governance frameworks aligned with business objectives, regulatory expectations, and enterprise risk appetite.

· Drive the identification, assessment, measurement, monitoring, and mitigation of technology risks across the technology organization.

· Provide independent and effective challenge to technology initiatives, control environments, and risk decisions.

· Partner with executive leadership to prioritize technology risk reduction efforts and strengthen overall operational resilience.

Technology Service Delivery Risk Oversight:

Provide risk oversight and governance for technology programs and services including:

· Asset Management

· Asset Configuration Management

· Enterprise Architecture

· IT Service Management (ServiceNow)

· CI/CD Pipelines and DevSecOps practices

· Database Platforms and Data Services

· API Management and Integration Services

· Cloud and Platform Services

· Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Incident Management Programs

· Emerging Technology initiatives, including Generative AI capabilities

Governance, Monitoring & Reporting:

· Report and Interpret technology risk metrics, key risk indicators (KRIs), vendor risk scorecards, and executive reporting.

· Monitor risk exposures, identify emerging trends, and provide actionable recommendations to senior leadership.

· Interpret threshold breaches, direct root cause analyses, and hold stakeholders accountable for corrective actions and measurable risk reduction.

· Prepare and deliver executive-level reporting to risk committees, governance forums, and senior leadership teams.

· Drive continuous improvement of technology risk management practices, controls, and reporting capabilities.

Regulatory, Audit & Risk Management Engagement:

· Serve as the senior Technology Risk representative for regulatory examinations, internal audits, and Independent Risk Management reviews.

· Lead responses to regulatory findings, audit observations, and risk assessment outcomes.

· Translate evolving regulatory requirements and industry expectations into practical risk management and control requirements.

· Ensure technology risk programs remain aligned with governance standards, regulatory guidance, and enterprise policies.

Partnership & Influence:

· Build strong partnerships across:

o Technology

o Enterprise Third-Party Management

o Information Security

o Enterprise Architecture

o Resilience and Business Continuity

o Supply Chain

o Legal

o Independent Risk Management

o Internal Audit

· Influence strategic decisions regarding technology investments, vendor partnerships, cloud adoption, contract negotiations, contingency planning, and vendor exit strategies.

· Provide leadership in balancing risk management objectives with business and technology priorities.

People Leadership:

· Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of technology risk management professionals.

· Establish clear performance expectations and risk-based oversight plans.

· Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

· Build organizational capability and technical depth in technology risk management practices.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage. We are united in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers while fostering an inclusive workplace where employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute to the company's success.

As a Senior Finance Associate within the Corporate & Institutional Banking (C&IB) Finance organization, you will support the PNC Real Estate business, with a primary focus on the Multifamily Capital platform. This Pittsburgh-based, onsite role offers a unique opportunity to combine accounting, financial reporting, forecasting, strategic analysis, and executive-level partnership within a dynamic and growing line of business.

This position is ideal for an accounting or finance professional looking to broaden their experience beyond traditional accounting responsibilities and gain exposure to business strategy, executive decision-making, regulatory reporting, and enterprise-wide financial initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Financial & Management Reporting

• Prepare and analyze monthly financial results, management reports, and key business metrics.
• Partner with Finance and business leaders to explain performance drivers, identify trends, and communicate insights that support strategic decision-making.
• Perform detailed variance analysis and develop reporting that improves visibility into business performance.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Planning

• Support the annual budgeting process and monthly forecasting cycles.
• Analyze financial results, market trends, and business activity to assess impacts on future performance.
• Communicate forecast changes and financial risks to Finance and line-of-business leadership.

Accounting & Financial Close

• Support month-end and quarter-end financial close processes.
• Partner with Accounting Policy, SEC Reporting, Regulatory Reporting, and Corporate Finance teams to ensure accurate financial reporting and compliance with accounting standards.
• Analyze accounting impacts of new business initiatives, transactions, and evolving accounting guidance.
• Assist with financial disclosures and reporting requirements supporting SEC filings, Earnings Call & Board materials, regulatory submissions, and other external reporting needs.

Strategic & Business Advisory Support

• Collaborate with business leaders to support strategic planning and financial initiatives.
• Assist in evaluating growth opportunities, business investments, and financial impacts of key decisions.
• Serve as a trusted finance partner by providing analytical support and actionable insights.

Regulatory & Stress Testing Activities

• Support CCAR stress testing activities and related financial analyses.
• Partner with key Finance stakeholders to evaluate and challenge forecast assumptions and stress-testing results.
• Contribute to regulatory, capital planning, and risk management deliverables.
Process Improvement & Special Projects
• Drive continuous improvement efforts focused on reporting efficiency, controls, and data quality.
• Support technology initiatives, process automation, business integrations, and enterprise-wide Finance projects.
• Respond to ad hoc analyses and executive requests while participating in cross-functional initiatives involving Finance, Technology, Legal, M&A, Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams.

What We're Looking For

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

• Strong accounting and financial reporting knowledge.
• Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to interpret complex financial data and communicate findings effectively.
• Attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
• Strong partnership and collaboration skills across multiple stakeholder groups.
• Interest in expanding beyond accounting into strategic finance and business advisory responsibilities.

This role offers significant exposure to Finance leadership and the PNC Real Estate executive team while providing hands-on experience across accounting, reporting, forecasting, strategic planning, and regulatory initiatives. The RM Virtual position manages a large book of business (400+ clients) in the $2-10MM segment. The objective is to maintain and grow the book of business.
